video_title: A HUGE Question For The Knicks’ Future + Is OKC Committed To Spending? & Kawhi Extension Reaction

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks are far apart on extension talks
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks are very far apart in contract extension talks.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks are very far apart in contract extension talks. You never say never, there are many days until the start of the season, but right now it looks unlikely that they are going to come to an agreement.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns has a $61 million player option for next season
quotes.excerpt: What is it, a $61 million player option for next season?
quotes.quote: He is under contract for this season and as you pointed out, what is it, a $61 million player option for next season?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns is in a great place professionally after the championship
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns is in a great place professionally coming off the championship.
quotes.quote: I think it is something, it is not everything, and I do not think this is a toxic situation. I credit Karl-Anthony Towns for that. I just think Karl-Anthony Towns is in a great place professionally coming off the championship, having certainly quieted a lot of criticism about him and his perceived flaws. Honestly, he did a great job defensively in the finals, much less what he means to them on the offensive end of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The second apron is a deterrent for teams without a championship
quotes.excerpt: The second apron is a threshold that is meant to be a deterrent.
quotes.quote: The second apron is a threshold that is meant to be a deterrent, yes because of the tax money that you pay. But tax money has been high for years now. It is so that you cannot adjust your team. Once you get into the second apron, all the mechanisms that you can to adjust your team are taken away. So, I would say that the second apron is not a place you want to be if you do not have a championship team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks need Karl-Anthony Towns to take a pay cut
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks need Karl-Anthony Towns to take a new contract that lowers that $61 million number.
quotes.quote: It is not just the Knicks want to have Karl-Anthony Towns in a contract that makes less money. The Knicks need Karl-Anthony Towns to take a new contract that lowers that $61 million number. And he can just say, I will pick it up and you deal with it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti is very cautious and studied when speaking publicly
quotes.excerpt: I cannot underscore enough how cautious and studied Sam Presti is.
quotes.quote: I cannot underscore enough how cautious and studied Sam Presti is. He does not speak flippantly.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder saved over $300 million in salary and taxes this summer
quotes.excerpt: They saved like $300-some-odd million dollars in salary and taxes this summer.
quotes.quote: And they saved like $300-some-odd million dollars in salary and taxes this summer.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti is very cautious about talking to Thunder fans
quotes.excerpt: Sam Presti has always been very cautious to talk directly to the Oklahoma City fans.
quotes.quote: Throughout his tenure, he has always been very cautious to talk directly to the Oklahoma City fans. His interviews also go national, but Sam Presti talks to the fans.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti's comments suggest future financial flexibility for the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: The savings generated this summer will be reallocated to future teams.
quotes.quote: The impression that I have been given is that the savings generated this summer and from being out of the luxury tax for the last several years will be reallocated to future teams. And as I understand it, the decisions this summer have positioned us financially to maintain a team of this caliber.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder's new arena will cost the franchise $50 million
quotes.excerpt: The new arena only costs the franchise $50 million.
quotes.quote: The new arena only costs the franchise $50 million.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder ownership is looking at a windfall of $500-600 million
quotes.excerpt: They are looking at a windfall of between $500 and $600 million.
quotes.quote: I talked to one owner who said that they believe that they are looking at a windfall of between $500 and $600 million.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard signed a two-year, $115 million extension with the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard signed a two-year, $115 million extension with the franchise.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard signed a two-year, $115 million extension with the franchise, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's extension is a huge risk for the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: This is a huge, huge risk for the Raptors.
quotes.quote: This is a huge, huge extension for a player with major durability issues who is in his mid-30s. It is $25 million more than Kevin Durant got. It is not a long-term risk, but it is a big, big risk for the Raptors.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Clippers broke rules because Kawhi Leonard is a generational talent
quotes.excerpt: The reason the Clippers broke all these rules and did all this is because Kawhi Leonard is a generational talent.
quotes.quote: The reason the Clippers broke all these rules and did all this is because Kawhi Leonard is a generational talent. Unfortunately for the Clippers, they got caught, and he was not a generational talent for the first five and a half years. But the last year and a half, he has been awesome.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Raptors' extension for Kawhi Leonard is too much money
quotes.excerpt: I think it is too much money and I do not think it gives them a lot of wiggle room.
quotes.quote: I think it is too much money and I do not think it gives them a lot of wiggle room to make further upgrades. And they still have a pretty significant hole in the roster at center, I think.
